finalText:
Build's clean now, exit 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under the deprecation noise. `resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` was still reading `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. And `isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw whenever a flag was left unset, because the new config loader gives `undefined` instead of `false`.

Fixed both: retries now reads `retryCount`, and an unset backoff flag is just treated as disabled. Build now finishes with only the expected 8 deprecation warnings, no errors.
